finding: The read service rejected invalid page values before database access, but the FastAPI route accepted unbounded strings and its OpenAPI contract did not publish the service limits.
change: The route now declares typed FastAPI Query bounds matching the service. Invalid and non-integer values return 422 before invoking the service; valid values are forwarded as integers.
rollback: Revert the route-level Query types/bounds and corresponding test assertions; no schema, persisted state, or service behavior changed.
limitations: Checks cover in-process validation and OpenAPI output only; no live reverse proxy or database behavior was exercised.
